name: toybox4
author: ghjob360
tagline: an OP-1-style four-track pocket studio: 11 engines, 9 effects, 7 sequencers, a tape with tricks, a sampler
description: Four tracks, each with a synth and a drum instrument. Eleven synth engines, a 24-key drum kit or a 24-slice sampled kit, nine effects, five LFOs that reach any parameter, seven sequencers (loop, grid, spin, hands, draw, arp, latch), a 128-bar four-track event tape with varispeed, reverse and sixteen tape tricks, a mixer with EQ, master effect and output stage, and a sampler that records the output into flash. Every module is an animated picture drawn in the four knobs' colours.
credits: built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hugelton Instruments)
